mapper.select: SELECT tr.case_id AS case_id, tc.name AS case_name, COALESCE(stc.site_name, '未知') AS site_name, COALESCE(tr.status, '未知') AS execute_status, COALESCE(tr.duration_ms, 0) AS execute_time, tr.run_time AS create_time, COALESCE(tr.message, '无') AS fail_reason, COALESCE(tr.screenshot_path, '无') AS screenshot_path FROM test_result tr LEFT JOIN test_case tc ON tr.case_id = tc.id LEFT JOIN site_test_config stc ON tc.site_code = stc.site_code ORDER BY tr.run_time DESC
